## Near-cap code block

This 15-line block must fit in presentation mode without scrolling.

```r
library(dichromat)
library(paletteer)
colorblind_palette <- function(palette) {
  melt(as.data.table(
    append(
      list(x = seq_along(palette), Original = palette),
      lapply(c(Protanopia = "protan", Deuteranopia = "deutan"),
        dichromat, colours = palette)
    ),
    id.vars = "x"
  )) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = 0, fill = value)) +
    geom_raster() + facet_wrap(vars(variable), nrow = 4)
}
```

## Long code

```python
def summarize(values):
    count = len(values)
    total = sum(values)
    mean = total / count
    centered = [value - mean for value in values]
    squares = [value * value for value in centered]
    variance = sum(squares) / (count - 1)
    standard_deviation = variance ** 0.5
    minimum = min(values)
    maximum = max(values)
    span = maximum - minimum
    return {
        "count": count,
        "mean": mean,
        "standard_deviation": standard_deviation,
        "minimum": minimum,
        "maximum": maximum,
        "span": span,
    }
```

::: notes
The PDF renderer should expose a visible overflow cue or fail its overflow check rather than silently clipping code.
:::

## Implicit figure stretch {#implicit-figure-stretch}

![](../../examples/assets/estimate.svg){fig-alt="A lone figure that must fill the slide even though it is not tagged for stretch"}

::: {.aside}
Quarto's auto-stretch skips every slide that carries an aside, so the format
restores it for a lone untagged figure like this one.
:::

## Captioned figure with an aside {#captioned-figure-stretch}

![A caption that must keep its own line below the figure](../../examples/assets/estimate.svg){fig-alt="A captioned figure that must fit above the aside"}

::: {.aside}
A captioned figure keeps Quarto's `<figure>` wrapper, so it fills the slide by
layout instead of by the stretch class.
:::

## Linked figure is not navigation {#linked-figure}

[![](../../examples/assets/estimate.svg){fig-alt="A figure wrapped in an internal link"}](#implicit-figure-stretch)

::: {.aside}
A lone figure wrapped in an internal link is a clickable figure, not a
navigation row, so it must not dock at the bottom of the slide.
:::
